entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return my VeloBand. I know I might be too late, but we had a family emergency and I just couldn't deal with it sooner.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?

Oh no, the band is fine. It's just... my husband had to be rushed to the hospital. He needed emergency surgery and it's just been a complete nightmare. With everything going on, we just really need the money back. I've been a loyal customer for years and I was hoping you could help.
Of course. I completely understand, and I sincerely hope he's recovering well. Let me just pull up your account and take a look at the policy for your VeloBand GPS Tracker. One moment please.

Alright, I have your order details here. And actually, I have some good news for you. There's no need to worry about being late. The VeloBand GPS Tracker has a 90-day return window, and you are well within that period.

Wait, really? Ninety days? Oh, thank goodness. I was so stressed. After his sudden surgery and that trip to the emergency room, I just lost track of all the details. I thought I only had a week or so.

Not at all. I'm glad I can take one thing off your plate. We can absolutely process this as a standard return for a full refund. I'm generating the return shipping label for you now and sending it to the email on your account. Do you still have the original box?
Yes, I do. This is such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you so much, Charlie.

You are very welcome. Just print that label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. I wish your husband a full and speedy recovery. Have a good rest of your day.
